risk: A delayed registration callback can queue changed_work after unregister has already completed cancel_work_sync(changed_work). device_unregister may then release the object while changed_work is pending or running.

candidate_identity.canonical_docker_snapshot: source, map and module hashes match the repository candidate

zte_power_supply_deferred_register_work: when parent is absent, skips the removing check
when device_trylock(parent) succeeds, skips the removing check
zte_power_supply_changed: sets event_pending and calls pm_stay_awake under psy->lock
observed_order.release: The pinned device core implements device_unregister as device_del followed by put_device; the final reference invokes device_release. zte_power_supply_dev_release frees the containing zte_power_supply with kfree. The changed_work callback does not acquire a device reference for its own psy.

interleaving: unregister sets removing and cancel_work_sync returns while changed_work is idle
the delayed callback is already running and takes a path that does not test removing
the delayed callback calls zte_power_supply_changed and queues changed_work
cancel_delayed_work_sync waits for the delayed callback but does not cancel the newly queued changed_work
device_unregister may drop the final device reference and free psy before changed_work runs
kernel_contract: The pinned kernel documents cancel_work_sync as guaranteeing no pending/executing work only when there are no racing enqueues. The delayed callback is an internal racing enqueuer because it is drained only after cancel_work_sync(changed_work).
scope_and_limits: This is a statically derived lifetime window inherited from the OEM stock ordering; the reconstructed unregister and deferred-work functions match the stock assembly evidence.
The interleaving and use-after-free were not reproduced at runtime.
This finding covers the internal deferred-work producer. Callers of the exported change API must still stop using psy before unregister, according to the caller lifetime contract.
No device operation, module load/unload, or hardware test was performed.
recommended_correction: If hardening is selected, set the removal state with explicit single-access semantics, drain deferred_register_work before changed_work, then update the function mapping as a declared non-stock hardening deviation; rebuild and re-review the candidate before promotion.
reconstruction_status: The candidate remains an offline static reconstruction; exact stock mapping is preserved and this inherited lifetime risk is open. Independent review and hardware validation remain pending.
